bibl.title: La κοινότης metodica secondo P. Oxy. LII 3654, fr. 8 verso.
bibl.seg: Domenico Pellegrino, La κοινότης metodica secondo P. Oxy. LII 3654, fr. 8 verso.
bibl.note: Linguistic and philological analysis of the text of P. Oxy. LII, 3654 (= MP3 2360.2; LDAB 245), which yields a precious definition of the κοινότης, the most important theoretical element of the Methodism.
